notes: §1985:VIII.4.5.4 GR7: INTO may be written 'If only one record description is subordinate to the file description entry' or 'If all record-names associated with file-name-1 and the data item referenced by identifier-1 describe a group item or an elementary alphanumeric item'. StatementValidation.CheckIntoReceiver admits by count (IntoPhraseRules.Read) and otherwise asks AdmitsIntoRecord of every record and AdmitsIntoOperand of identifier-1 (ItemCategory.IsAlphanumericOrNational), refusing with COBOL1994; no edition gate is needed because the 2023 widenings (national items, typed groups) cannot be declared at 85. Witness: one-record files read INTO a group and INTO a numeric item. Probes (two records, d/b): second record PIC 9(6), PIC A(6), PIC XXBXXX, S9(4)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE each refused COBOL1994; two PIC X records INTO numeric, alphabetic, edited WS items refused; INTO PIC X, INTO WN(1:6) (reference modification is alphanumeric), INTO an OCCURS DEPENDING group and INTO a RENAMES THRU group accepted and read ABC123; INTO a RENAMES of one numeric item refused. A record-less FD (RECORD CONTAINS 6 only) compiles at 85 with READ INTO: the FD itself breaks §1985:VIII.3.2.3 SR3, open as kb/Work PB5071; READ INTO another record of the same file is kb/Work PB5077 (SR1).

next.reason: 1985: "a. If only one record description is subordinate to the file description entry"; 2023: "a) If no record description entry or only one record description is subordinate to the file description entry". Same INTO permission rule, but 2023 adds the case of no record description entry (see GR-6) and extends condition b to category national items.
